narrative.intro: Westat has $260M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Westat received 159 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $1.6M and obligations up 31.6% year over year. The Department of Health and Human Services accounts for the largest share of obligations at $184M, followed by the Department of Education at $63.2M. Research and development drives the work: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences accounts for $86.7M, and Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities accounts for $69.7M. Marketing Research and Public Opinion Polling accounts for $43.7M, and Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services accounts for $31M. The FY2026 totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and all figures on the page represent contract obligations except where award-value figures are explicitly noted as total contract values.

sections.heading: How did Westat perform year over year?
sections.body: Westat obligations are up 31.6% year over year. Westat recorded $260M in obligations in FY2026 to date compared with prior-year totals shown on the page. Westat received 159 awards so far this fiscal year with an average award size of $1.6M.

sections.heading: Who are Westat's top buyers and markets?
sections.body: The Department of Health and Human Services is the largest buyer with $184M in obligations, followed by the Department of Education with $63.2M. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences is the largest market at $86.7M, followed by Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities at $69.7M and Marketing Research and Public Opinion Polling at $43.7M.

faq.q: How much does Westat make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Westat has $260M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Westat received 159 awards so far this fiscal year, and the average award size is $1.6M. These totals are partial, fiscal year to date.

The Department of Health and Human Services is the largest buyer, with $184M in obligations. The Department of Education is the second largest buyer, with $63.2M, followed by the Department of Veterans Affairs with $3.4M and other agencies listed down to the Department of Agriculture with $272K.

faq.q: What does Westat sell to the government?
faq.a: Westat sells research and related services, led by Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences at $86.7M. Westat also provides Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities at $69.7M, Marketing Research and Public Opinion Polling at $43.7M, and Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services at $31M.
